projectDescription: A sub-second, deterministic static analysis CLI that scores your codebase 0–100 by catching the patterns AI coding agents leave behind — narrative comments, swallowed exceptions, dead code, unsafe type casts, and more — across 8 languages with 50+ rules.
keyFeatures: 50+ deterministic rules across TypeScript, JavaScript, Expo/React Native, Python, Go, Rust, Ruby, and PHP
0–100 code quality score with AI-slop-first weighting
Auto-fix command that applies mechanical fixes and hands off remaining issues to any AI coding agent
CI quality gate with configurable thresholds and SARIF output
Pre-commit and agent hook integration for real-time feedback
MCP server exposing scan/fix tools to Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Codex
No LLM at runtime — fully deterministic, sub-second results
VS Code extension with inline diagnostics and status-bar score
Architecture engine for custom import and layering rules (opt-in)
Config inheritance via `extends:` for monorepo and org-wide baselines
publicApiSurface: aislop-mcp (MCP server: aislop_scan, aislop_fix, aislop_why, aislop_baseline)
.aislop/config.yml (version, engines, quality, scoring, ci, telemetry, rules, exclude, include, extends)
